cli.stdout:
AI Account Center

Usage: ai-account-center <command> [options]

Commands:
  dashboard      Open the account and usage dashboard
  codex-auth     Save Codex logins whose usage the dashboard reads
  antigravity    Add or sign in again to a saved Antigravity profile on Ubuntu
  bar            Install, launch, or inspect the native account bar
  help           Show command help
  version        Show version and installation paths

Compatibility: ccs uses the same commands; config is an alias for dashboard.
Global option: --config-dir PATH selects the existing account configuration directory.

Examples:
  ai-account-center dashboard --host localhost --port 3000 --no-open
  ai-account-center dashboard store status
  ai-account-center codex-auth show
  ai-account-center codex-auth login work
  ai-account-center antigravity signin party
  ai-account-center bar version

AI Account Center v8.10.0
Installation: <executable>
Account configuration: <fixture-home>/.ccs
Config: <fixture-home>/.ccs/config.json
License: MIT; derived from CCS by Tam Nhu Tran (Kai).
Run 'ai-account-center --help' for usage information.

Usage: ai-account-center dashboard [command] [options]
Compatibility: ccs config accepts the same arguments.

Open the account and usage dashboard.

Commands:
  proxy status       Show whether the LAN HTTPS reverse proxy is trusted
  proxy set --address <ip> --origin <https url>   Trust the LAN HTTPS proxy
  proxy off          Stop trusting the LAN HTTPS proxy
  store status       Show the history store state and last backup
  store check|backup|restore <dir>   Check, back up or restore it (dashboard stopped)

Managed in the dashboard's Settings page (the CLI points there):
  dashboard sign-in (auth), the usage hub key, the usage snapshot folder, the Cursor key

Options:
  --port, -p PORT    Server port (default: auto-detect)
  --host, -H HOST    Bind host (default: localhost)
  --no-open         Start the server without opening a browser
  --help, -h        Show this help message

Linux service startup never opens a browser automatically.

Examples:
  ai-account-center dashboard --host localhost --port 3000 --no-open
  ai-account-center dashboard store status

    Use ai-account-center dashboard for accounts and usage.
    Use ai-account-center codex-auth show to inspect saved Codex logins.
    Use ai-account-center codex-auth activate <saved-login> to activate the shared login.
    Shell exports, isolated CODEX_HOME launches, Droid routing, and CLIProxy launches are retired.
